tutorial.board: From the 5x5 grid, pick two adjacent (orthogonal or diagonal) cards of the same rank to remove them.
tutorial.remove: Tap the first card, then tap an adjacent same-rank card. Both cells become empty.
tutorial.deal: When no pair is visible, press Deal to compress the board to the top-left and fill empties from the stock.
tutorial.controls: Use the buttons below to Deal, Undo, Give Up, or Reset the game.
tutorial.win: Remove all 52 cards to clear the game. If the stock is empty and no pairs remain, it's game over.

hint.removePair: Remove the highlighted adjacent same-rank pair
hint.deal: Press Deal to compress the board
